name: Hyoutei Musou
source:
Main character moves to a new town after his father's transfer. He enters the only bourgeois school of the area and tries to reach the top social position with his skill of tennis play.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-june-2003-sayonara.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角因父亲调职搬到新城镇。他进入当地唯一的贵族学校，凭借网球技术努力登上社会地位顶端。

[来源：[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-june-2003-sayonara.html]vndbreview[/url]]
